title: Klammerdiagramm — yatpādāmbhojasevāruciśucimanasām (Leitan comparison)
desc: The first half-compound of Leitan's Jalhaṇa stanza (Sūktimuktāvalī): yat-pāda-ambhoja-sevā-ruci-śuci-manasām — whose minds are pure through the light of service to the lotus-feet of whom — following Leitan's own right-to-left ladder: upamita pair A = pāda+ambhoja, chain B = yat+[A] (the deepest rung of his indentation), then mirrored accretions C–F: +sevā, +ruci, +śuci, +manasām. II часть at ruci (asked). Drawn for the H982 comparison.
